onboarding.step1_desc: You'll create and manage your own company over several weeks. Each real day = 1 virtual month of operations. Every day you make business decisions, and that night the monthly results are calculated.
onboarding.step2_desc: Choose your product, location, prices, employees and marketing. But be careful: the budget is limited. You can't do everything at once.
onboarding.step3_desc: Money you don't use in the business can be invested. More risk = more potential return. The key is balance.
onboarding.step4_desc: The next day you see the monthly report: how your decisions impacted performance, how much you sold, what market events occurred, and where you stand in the ranking.

company.create_subtitle: These decisions are permanent. Think carefully!
company.irrevocable_warning: ⚠️ This decision is permanent. Changing it would be very costly.
company.product_hint: Each product has advantages and disadvantages. There's no clearly superior one.
company.location_hint: Location affects demand based on your product. The right combination is key.
company.confirm_warning: Once created, you can't change the product or location.

dashboard.title: My company
dashboard.decisions_open: 📋 You can submit this month's decisions
dashboard.decisions_locked: 🔒 Decisions submitted — Monthly report available tomorrow

decisions.title: Decisions — Month {round}
decisions.subtitle: Make this month's operating decisions. You can't allocate more capital than you have.
decisions.research_desc: Get information about the next month. The more you invest, the more detail you get.
decisions.investments_desc: Invest money you don't use in the business. More risk = more potential return.
decisions.confirm_warning: Once submitted, you can't change them. The monthly report will be available tomorrow.
decisions.min_employees: Recommended minimum: {n} employees for this product

results.subtitle: Here's how your company did this month
results.stock_shortfall: Lost sales due to stock shortage

savings.name: Safe account
savings.desc: Guaranteed return, very low risk. Ideal for preserving capital.

bond.name: Fictitious bond
bond.desc: Fictitious government debt. Stable and predictable medium-term.

conservative_fund.name: Conservative fund
conservative_fund.desc: Diversified low-risk portfolio. Better than a savings account.

balanced_fund.name: Balanced fund
balanced_fund.desc: Mix of stocks and bonds. Moderate risk, reasonable return.

stocks.name: Fictitious stocks
stocks.desc: High volatility. You could gain a lot or lose quite a bit in one round.

crypto.name: Fictitious crypto
crypto.desc: Very high volatility. Can multiply or crash within days.

startup.name: Fictitious startup
startup.desc: High-risk investment. If it takes off: spectacular return. If it fails: big loss.

bikes.name: Urban Bicycles
bikes.desc: High cost, good margin. Quality and location are everything.

skateboards.name: Skateboards
skateboards.desc: Low cost, high youth demand. Branding is the key.

escooters.name: Electric Scooters
escooters.desc: The most expensive and risky. Potential for very high margins.

backpacks.name: Smart Backpacks
backpacks.desc: Stable demand in educational zones. Design matters a lot.

bottles.name: Thermal Bottles
bottles.desc: High volume, low margin product. Key: differentiation.

headphones.name: Sports Headphones
headphones.desc: High demand, heavy competition. Without marketing, you don't exist.

school.name: School zone
school.desc: Teenage market. Moderate and predictable traffic.

university.name: University zone
university.desc: Young adults with their own budget. High receptiveness to trends.

mall.name: Shopping mall
mall.desc: Maximum traffic, maximum competition. High rent.

residential.name: Residential neighborhood
residential.desc: Low but loyal traffic. Minimal risk, cheap rent.

tourist.name: Tourist zone
tourist.desc: Very variable. Big opportunities in peak season.

sports.name: Sports zone
sports.desc: Active and specific audience. Good synergy with physical products.

great_fit.title: Excellent combination!
great_fit.msg: Your product works very well in this location (fit: {fit}). Keep optimizing.

poor_fit.title: Bad product-location match
poor_fit.msg: Your product doesn't fit well here (fit: {fit}). Consider relocating.
poor_fit.learn: Product-location compatibility can multiply or divide your demand.

stock_out.title: Ran out of stock!
stock_out.msg: You lost {units} potential sales (approx. ${lost}). Produce more next round.
stock_out.learn: Running out of stock loses immediate sales and reduces customer satisfaction.

overstock.title: Overstock
overstock.msg: {units} units left over. Adjust production to match actual demand.

liquidity_crisis.title: ⚠️ Liquidity crisis
liquidity_crisis.msg: Your capital dropped below 15% of the start. This will penalize the next round.
liquidity_crisis.learn: Always keep some liquidity for emergencies and opportunities.

no_marketing.title: No marketing
no_marketing.msg: You didn't invest in marketing. Your base demand drops significantly.
no_marketing.learn: Marketing isn't an expense — it's an investment in future demand.

great_marketing.title: Effective marketing!
great_marketing.msg: Your campaign boosted demand by {effect}% above base.

quality_mismatch.title: Quality inconsistency
quality_mismatch.msg: You're using cheap materials with premium positioning. This erodes your brand.
quality_mismatch.learn: Premium customers expect quality. Mismatch destroys brand trust.

profitable.title: Profitable month!
profitable.msg: Your capital grew {pct}% this month. Well done!

loss.title: Month with a loss
loss.msg: You lost ${loss} this month. Analyze costs and adjust your strategy.
loss.learn: Occasional losses are normal. What matters is learning what caused them.

understaffed.title: Understaffed
understaffed.msg: Operational efficiency was low due to insufficient staff. Consider hiring more.

viral_trend_bikes.name: Viral trend — mobility
viral_trend_bikes.desc: A viral video spiked interest in bikes and electric scooters.

school_season.name: School season
school_season.desc: Start of the school year. Backpacks and bottles in high demand.

sports_event.name: Local sports event
sports_event.desc: A regional tournament filled sports and tourist zones.

new_competitor.name: New competitor
new_competitor.desc: A new business entered the market in the main zones.

good_reviews.name: Viral positive reviews
good_reviews.desc: An influencer praised your type of product. Demand rising.

bad_reviews.name: Negative reviews
bad_reviews.desc: Social media complaints about similar products. Demand dropped.

eco_trend.name: Sustainability boom
eco_trend.desc: The eco-friendly movement boosted demand for mobility products.

economic_upswing.name: Economic upswing
economic_upswing.desc: The fictitious economy grew. Consumers have more to spend.

mild_recession.name: Mild recession
mild_recession.desc: Consumption fell. Premium products were most affected.

viral_social_media.name: Viral on social media
viral_social_media.desc: Skateboards and headphones went viral among young people.

supply_disruption.name: Supply chain disruption
supply_disruption.desc: Supply chain issues hit. Costs rose 35%.

local_festival.name: Local festival
local_festival.desc: A massive festival filled the tourist and commercial zones.

tax_break.name: Tax break
tax_break.desc: The fictitious government reduced taxes. Costs drop 12%.

influencer_collab.name: Influencer collaboration
influencer_collab.desc: A mega-influencer praised products like yours.

tech_regulation.name: New tech regulation
tech_regulation.desc: The fictitious government regulated e-scooters and crypto. More costs.

crypto_boom.name: Crypto boom
crypto_boom.desc: Digital assets skyrocketed. Crypto and startup investors gained big.

partnership_opportunity.name: Partnership opportunity
partnership_opportunity.desc: A company wants to distribute your product. You need liquidity to grab it.

inflation_spike.name: Inflation spike
inflation_spike.desc: Fictitious inflation raised costs and reduced purchasing power.

research.demand_forecast: Estimated demand: {low} to {high} units for your product this round.
research.high_competition: Competition in {location} is high ({pct}%). Differentiation is key.
research.price_sensitive: Your segment is very price-sensitive. Lowering price can significantly increase demand.
research.price_tolerant: Your segment is not very price-sensitive. You can charge more without losing much demand.
research.early_game_tip: In early rounds, building brand is more important than maximizing profit.
research.mid_game_tip: Mid-game, the balance between growth and efficiency is key.
research.late_game_tip: In the final rounds, consolidating gains is as important as continuing to grow.
research.event_hint: Analysts detect signals of a possible '{eventType}' event next round.
research.no_clear_event: No clear signals of exceptional events for next round.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.budget_exceeded: You can't allocate more than your available capital.
errors.round_locked: This round is closed. Wait for the results.
errors.company_exists: You already have a company in this game.
